learning_objective: 🎯 Explore how your body moves through space, build your balance, and learn to express your feelings through awesome physical movements!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just like a musician uses a guitar, a dancer uses their whole body to make art! From waving your arms to tapping your toes, every movement you make can tell a unique story.
When you move, you use the space around you. You can stretch super high on your tiptoes to reach the sky, or crouch low to the ground like a crawling tiger. Changing levels makes movement fun!
Balance means keeping your body steady without falling over. Good posture, like keeping your back straight and your core strong, helps you balance like a superhero standing on one leg.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Freeze Statue Game
fun_activity.instructions: Play your favorite upbeat song and dance wildly around the room. Have a friend pause the music suddenly, and you must freeze instantly in whatever funny or cool shape your body is making!

quick_recap: ⭐ Your body is your main tool for expressing art through dance and movement.
⭐ You can make your dancing interesting by moving in high, medium, and low spaces.
⭐ Having a good posture is the secret to keeping your balance while moving.
⭐ Every jump, twist, and turn is a way to share your feelings without saying a single word.
